nodes.description: Private owner address of the Ownable contract; controls all onlyOwner-gated functionality.
Constructor that sets _owner to msg.sender and emits OwnershipTransferred.
View function returning the current _owner address.
Modifier requiring isOwner() before executing the guarded function body.
onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0), permanently removing ownership.
onlyOwner function forwarding the new owner to _transferOwnership.
Internal function validating newOwner and writing it into the _owner state variable.
Caller-controlled address used in the constructor and in isOwner authorization checks.
Address parameter supplied by the owner to transferOwnership.
Address parameter of the internal _transferOwnership function.
Public oracle price value exposed by MarketPriceOracle.getData.
onlyOwner function writing a new reported market price into currentMarketPrice.
Owner-supplied 18-decimal fixed point price argument written verbatim into state.
Privileged write of the _owner state variable performed inside _transferOwnership.
Unvalidated write of the oracle price into currentMarketPrice inside pushReport.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the untrusted msg.sender value directly to the _owner state variable.
isOwner reads msg.sender and compares it against _owner.
onlyOwner modifier performs require(isOwner()) before the guarded body executes.
onlyOwner guards the entry point of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner guards the entry point of renounceOwnership.
transferOwnership calls the internal _transferOwnership function.
The caller-supplied newOwner is bound to transferOwnership's parameter.
newOwner argument is forwarded from transferOwnership into _transferOwnership.
The newOwner parameter flows into the privileged ownership state write.
The ownership write operation updates the _owner state variable.
The ownership write is executed within _transferOwnership.
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into the _owner state variable.
pushReport binds its caller argument to the currentMarketPrice_ parameter.
The unvalidated price parameter flows into the price state write operation.
The price write operation assigns the reported value into currentMarketPrice.
pushReport stores the reported price into the currentMarketPrice state variable.
getData reads currentMarketPrice when returning the aggregated oracle value.
The constructor initializes the _owner state variable.
owner() reads and returns the _owner state variable.
isOwner reads the _owner state variable for the authorization comparison.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter is only meaningful as an argument of transferOwnership and carries no independent semantics.
The internal parameter is a direct forwarding of the newOwner argument into _transferOwnership.
The price parameter exists solely as the input value consumed by pushReport.
